zh.title: 漢光42號實兵演習首日空軍戰機實施戰備轉場保存戰力
zh.summary: 國軍漢光42號實兵操演於8月5日展開。演習首日，空軍各型戰機實施戰備轉場前往指定地區以保存戰力，防空部隊全面戰備部署；海軍各式艦艇在完成整補後也緊急出港，前往指定的疏泊區待命，以防範敵軍「由演轉戰」及灰色地帶襲擾。
body: 國軍漢光42號實兵操演於2026年8月5日正式展開，演習預計實施至8月14日，共計10天9夜。首日演練重點主要為防範敵軍以灰色地帶襲擾，並預防敵方「由演轉戰」，陸海空三軍及防空部隊皆展開全面戰備部署與演練。
在具體部署方面，空軍各型戰機實施戰備轉場，前往指定地區以進行戰力保存，防空部隊亦全面部署。同時，海軍各式艦艇於完成整補後緊急出港，前往指定疏泊區待命，海軍機動雷達與飛彈車組亦前往戰術位置待命接戰，並完成水雷整備。

en.title: Han Kuang 42 Drills Begin as Air Force Relocates Jets for Combat Preservation
en.summary: The Han Kuang 42 live-fire military exercise commenced on August 5, 2026, and is scheduled to run for 10 days and 9 nights until August 14. On the first day of the major drills, Taiwan's Air Force fighter jets conducted tactical relocations to designated areas for combat preservation, while air defense forces were fully deployed in combat readiness. Simultaneously, Navy vessels completed replenishment and departed for designated anchorage areas to guard against potential grey-zone harassment and any transition from exercises to active combat by opposing forces.
body: The Han Kuang 42 live-fire military exercise began on August 5, 2026, and is scheduled to run for 10 days and 9 nights until August 14. The first day of the exercise focused on responding to potential grey-zone harassment and preventing any sudden transition from exercises to combat operations by opposing forces.

As part of the initial maneuvers, the Air Force relocated various fighter jets to designated areas for combat preservation, and air defense units deployed. Simultaneously, Navy vessels completed replenishment and departed for designated anchorage areas, while mobile radar and missile vehicle groups moved to tactical positions.
